Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — continuous-batching latency spike in us-west-2 (prod). Many requests stalled in queue; KV cache pressure rising. Auto-alert to #eng-oncall.

Aisha (oncall): seeing big queue growth on cb-worker nodes, latency 5-10x for some traffic. Prefetch KPIs jumping.

Lee (sre): confirmed. Microbatching stats: avg microbatch size ~ 48 (target 16), pending queue length hitting 1200. KV cache hit ratio dropping, eviction rate increasing.

Samira (runtime): looks like prefetch loop + aggressive continuous batching under sudden concurrency burst. Prefetch spawned many inflight requests then KV cache got saturated -> heavy evictions -> repeat.

Jorge (eng-runtime): any customer-facing errors? Marta, can you check support?

Marta (support): support telemetry: ~12 customers saw 5xx on generation endpoints, primary symptom is timeouts and partial streams. Small subset (org-42, org-88) experienced 30-60s tail latencies. No SLO breach yet but some elevated error rates.

Aisha (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle prefetch, 2) reduce max_microbatch_size, 3) enable conservative jitter, 4) temporary KV cache soft-cap. I'll push safe hotfix to prod gates.

Lee (sre): +1. Recommend rolling to a single AZ at a time. Keep an eye on autoscaler to avoid oscillations.

Samira (runtime): patch ready for quick deploy:

```yaml
continuous_batch:
  max_microbatch_size: 16   # was 64 in the problematic rollout
  prefetch_workers: 2       # was 8
  jitter_alpha: 0.7         # increase randomness to break sync
kv_cache:
  soft_entry_limit: 0.8     # stop new prefetched entries when 80% full
  eviction_rate_limit: 500  # cap evictions/sec to avoid cascade
```

Aisha (oncall): applying hotfix to us-west-2 canary now (cb-canary-3). Will monitor latency and queue depth.

Incident Bot: Deploy started by Aisha at 2897654332.

Lee (sre): monitoring: queue depth started to drop after canary patch. Microbatch size fell to median 18. KV eviction rate down ~70%.

Marta (support): customer impact update: error rate for org-42 dropped to baseline after canary. Notified customer that we're rolling mitigations; they confirmed improvement.

Jorge (eng-runtime): rolling hotfix to remaining nodes. Keeping prefetch throttled to 25% of baseline until we validate recovery.

Aisha (oncall): rolling now to us-west-2 primary (incremental). Watch for rollout regressions; if tail resets to >20s we abort.

Samira (runtime): adding temporary tracing flag to better capture prefetch loops and KV insertion bursts: `CB_PREFETCH_TRACE=1` for canary only.

Lee (sre): tweak autoscaler min replicas to avoid under-provisioning during rollouts. Setting min_replicas += 2 for 10m.

Incident Bot: Canary healthy at 2897654351. No obvious downstream errors.

Aisha (oncall): rolling to remaining nodes now. ETA finish ~ 5m. NextOncall, I'm going to hand this off after stable for 15m — please pick up final verification and runbook updates.

NextOncall (sre): acknowledged. Will watch til 2897655260 and then update playbook.

Marta (support): prepping status update for affected customers: brief note + apology + what happened + mitigation + followup IR. Will post when NextOncall confirms final state.

Jorge (eng-runtime): post-mortem action items (preliminary):
- Autoscaling/rate-feedback: prevent autoscaler from amplifying prefetch bursts.
- Prefetch circuit breaker: stronger backoff when KV pressure detected.
- Continuous-batching defaults: dial conservative values for public rollout.
- Improved telemetry: per-org queue/backpressure metrics.

Samira (runtime): will file PRs for the circuit breaker and default config.

Aisha (oncall): handing off: current status = stable, queue depth back to baseline, KV evictions normalized, canary + full roll complete. NextOncall to validate no regression and own final communication.

NextOncall (sre): taking over at 2897654372. I'll run a focused verification: 1) confirm per-AZ latency, 2) check long-tail (>10s) ratio, 3) validate autoscaler adjustments revert after stability.

Marta (support): will hold customer message until NextOncall greenlights.

Incident Bot: Pager resolved at 2897654389 — incident marked as mitigated.

NextOncall (sre): ack. I'll keep thread open for any followups and will open a proper incident doc with timeline and impact numbers.

Aisha (oncall): thanks team. Quick note: avoid reverting the conservative config until we have perf tests under controlled burst.

Samira (runtime): noted. I'll add regression tests to the CB harness to simulate prefetch storms.

Jorge (eng-runtime): adding a short-term dashboard to surface KV entry rate, eviction burst, and microbatch size percentiles.

Marta (support): thanks — will include those metrics in customer RCA.

NextOncall (sre): handing to followup owners: Samira (runtime) for fixes, Jorge (eng-runtime) for telemetry, Marta for customer comms. Closing handoff. :handshake:
